title: Advisor round one — review pack
intro: Four excerpts from IRL's public design register, each with the questions we're actually asking. Everything here is a current best call written to be corrected — please be direct.

excerpts.heading: 1. The locality register
excerpts.title: The locality register — draft effort bands
questions: Is Bremerton banded fairly from here?
Which band would you correct for the places you actually go — and is anything served that shouldn't be, or missing that should?

excerpts.title: The event-type register — nine seeded kinds
questions: Which of these nine kinds would this community actually recur on?
What recurring Bainbridge thing is missing from the list?

excerpts.title: Event policy — what belongs on IRL
questions: Does the honesty + non-coercion line cover what you'd worry about at a real event, or does it need a subject-matter line we've refused to draw?

excerpts.title: Protective blocks — the safety tier's mechanism
questions: Does the blocker-view design hold for the situations you've seen?
Where does the rendered-world rule break down in practice?
